    def bands(sep,size):
        out=[];cur=None;start=None
        for i in range(size):
            if i in sep:
                if cur is not None: out.append((start,i)); cur=None
            elif cur is None: cur=True; start=i
        if cur is not None: out.append((start,size))

    rb=bands(sr,H); cb=bands(sc,W)

            v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set(); seen[r][c]=True
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()

                        seen[ny][nx]=True; comp.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            if len(comp)>4:

    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if tmpl is not None:

        pc=(cb[-1][-1]-cb[0][0]+1)//len(cb)-1
        # compute periods: distances between consecutive band starts

        ps=[ps[0]] if ps else [5]
        q=lambda x,y: x//y if x%y==0 else x//y

        p0,pc0=(lambda b:[b[i+1][0] for i in range(len(b)-1)][0],None)

            for dy in range(0,H-by+p0,len(range(1))): pass

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1}
    sc_={j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0}
    rb=bands_of(sr,H); cb=bands_of(sc_,W)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if r in sr or c in sc_ or seen[r][c]: continue
            v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set(); seen[r][c]=True
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==v and ny not in sr and nx not in sc_:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; comp.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    tmpl=comps[0]
    tr=min(y for y,x in tmpl); tc_=min(x for y,x in tmpl)
    tpl=[(y-tr,x-tc_) for y,x in tmpl]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # seed color per band: nonzero cell at first slot of the band? Actually each slot has a seed in demo1?
    # determine seed color from first column band's slot (d2: seed '4' leftmost; d1?) check inputs
    return out if False else None

def comps_of(g,sr,sc_):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if r in sr or c in sc_ or seen[r][c]: continue
            v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set(); seen[r][c]=True
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                comp.add((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==v and ny not in sr and nx not in sc_:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
            out.append(comp)
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    g=G[n+' input']; o=G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1}
    sc_={j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0}
    cs=comps_of(g,sr,sc_)
    big=max(cs,key=len)
    tr=min(y for y,x in big); tc=min(x for y,x in big)
    tpl=sorted((y-tr,x-tc) for y,x in big)
    print(n,'tmpl rel:',tpl)
    # where is it? bbox
    print('   at rows',min(y for y,x in big),'-',max(y for y,x in big),'cols',min(x for y,x in big),'-',max(x for y,x in big))
    # stamp pattern from output band0 slot0 (TL anchor)
    srO={i for i in range(len(o)) if len(set(o[i]))==1}; scO={j for j in range(len(o[0])) if len({o[i][j] for i in range(len(o))})==1 and o[0][j]!=0}
    rbO=bands_of(srO,len(o)); cbO=bands_of(scO,len(o[0]))
    by=rbO[0][0]; sx=cbO[0][0]
    sp=sorted((r-by,c-sx) for r in range(by,min(rbO[0][-1]+1,len(o))) for c in range(sx,min(cbO[0][-1]+1,len(o[0]))) if o[r][c]!=0)
    print('   stamp rel:',sp)
    print('   match:', set(tpl)==set(sp))

def get(n):
    g=G[n+' input']; o=G[n+' output']
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1}
    sc_={j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(len(g))})==1 and g[0][j]!=0}
    rb=bands_of(sr,H); cb=bands_of(sc_,W)
    cs=comps_of(g,sr,sc_)
    def is_rect(c):
        ys=[y for y,x in c]; xs=[x for y,x in c]
        return len(c)==(max(ys)-min(ys)+1)*(max(xs)-min(xs)+1)
    tmpl=max(cs,key=len)
    tr=min(y for y,x in tmpl); tc_=min(x for y,x in tmpl)
    tpl={(y-tr,x-tc_) for y,x in tmpl}; th=max(y for y,x in tpl)+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for bi,b in enumerate(rb):
        by=min(b); sh=b[-1]-by+1; off=sh-th
        s=cb[0]
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in b for c in s if g[r][c]!=0 and r not in sr]
        seed=vals[0]
        for c in cb:
            sx=min(c)
            for ty,tx in tpl:
                rr,cc=by+off+ty,sx+tx
                out[rr][cc]=seed
    go=solve2(g)  # not yet defined - just print got vs exp
    return out

def solve5(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1}
    sc_={j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=0}
    rb=bands_of(sr,H); cb=bands_of(sc_,W)
    cs=comps_of(g,sr,sc_)
    def is_rect(c):
        ys=[y for y,x in c]; xs=[x for y,x in c]
        return len(c)==(max(ys)-min(ys)+1)*(max(xs)-min(xs)+1)
    tmpl=max([c for c in cs if not is_rect(c)],key=len)
    tr=min(y for y,x in tmpl); tc_=min(x for y,x in tmpl)
    tpl=sorted((y-tr,x-tc_) for y,x in tmpl); th=max(y for y,x in tpl)+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for b in rb:
        by=min(b); sh=b[-1]-by+1
        s=cb[0]
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in b for c in s if g[r][c]!=0 and r not in sr]
        seed=vals[0]
        for c in cb:
            sx=min(c)
            for ty,tx in tpl:
                rr,cc=by+(sh-th)+ty,sx+tx
                out[rr][cc]=seed
    return out
print('d1',solve5(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'],'d2',solve5(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])

print(json.dumps(solve5(G['Test input'])))
